mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a quarter indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic output and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) suggests accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods where FEDFUNDS was below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% each in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% each in a quarter signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during economic expansions.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 1% and GDPC1 increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 increased by more than 1% in a quarter during economic expansions.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% each in a quarter signals a strong supply side and labor market, which boosts economic output and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where both INDPRO increased and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in a quarter.
